messages:
Maria (CS): weekly spend sync - hosted API. quick heads-up: overall hosted spend is 18% over commit this week. two anomaly flags fired for customer accounts: 'Orchid' +45% and 'Zenith' +62%. noticed a small latency bump coincident with the spend spike. link to dashboard: https://console.redwood.ai/d/health/spend?range=7d :eyes:
Ajay (FinOps): can you drop the raw numbers? committed vs actual and which routes/models drove the extra tokens?
Maria (CS): sure — summary pasted below. Orchid: commit $12k/mo, this week burn ~$17.4k (+45%). Zenith: commit $8k/mo, this week burn ~$13k (+62%). top contribution: /v1/generate (hosted) using model rdx-3b-q4 with long sequences.
Jamie (SE): saw increased 5xx rate around 2026-03-18T03:20Z for those routes. logs show transient KV cache misses + retry storm. small tail latency increase (~120ms median -> 230ms p95).
Maria (CS): noted. cost-bot flagged both accounts for automatic alerting and sent an email to billing owners. cost-bot: "Anomaly detected: spend delta > 40% for Zenith, Orchid"
cost-bot: "Tickets created: #BILL-3421 (Zenith), #BILL-3422 (Orchid)"
Natalie (CSM): recommend proactive customer outreach today. propose a short enablement call to review batching + prompt trimming. i can schedule — do we have a playbook?
Jamie (SE): playbook link: https://redwood.ai/docs/optimize/batching -> key checks: 1) prefix caching enabled, 2) request size distribution, 3) model quantization mismatch. also run this quick query in insights:
```
SELECT route, sum(tokens) AS tokens, sum(cost) AS cost
FROM requests
WHERE account IN ('orchid','zenith') AND ts >= now() - interval '7 days'
GROUP BY route
ORDER BY tokens DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
Maria (CS): running that now, will paste results into the ticket. initial look: both accounts have a handful of long-history chat sessions that accidentally replay full convo each turn.
Ajay (FinOps): for renewal risk scoring: flag them medium-high until we confirm throttles/limits. can revenue ops add holdback note?
Natalie (CSM): yes — i'll add 'renewal: monitor' and request an enablement session. Maria — can you include suggested prompts for trimming and a sample rollout plan?
Maria (CS): will add. suggested quick mitigations: set per-route max_tokens to reasonable cap, enable prefix cache, apply temporary rate-limit to non-critical routes, offer dedicated batching config. i'll update tickets and ping the owners. :white_check_mark:
Jamie (SE): i'll open a short runbook for cache-miss mitigation and temporary fallback model (rdx-1b) to reduce tokens + cost.
Natalie (CSM): outreach draft — "we noticed increased usage that might be unintentional; we can help with batching/prompt design and a short audit" — ok to send? :+1:
Ajay (FinOps): yes. also add cost-forecast note: if current trend holds, Orchid will hit commit cap in 4 days and Zenith in 2 days. include suggested commit adjustment options or temporary throttles.
Maria (CS): timeline: outreach today, enablement call tomorrow, mitigation applied immediately if we see another 15% jump. i'll follow up in ticket with logs and the insights query results.
Natalie (CSM): thanks team. i'll draft the email and link the tickets.
Maria (CS): tagging summary for next week's sync: action items -> outreach, runbook for cache retries, temporary rate-limits, cost forecast update. will post a short recap in #customer-success-digest.
